items.title: Buddy Collette interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: In the reed section there was Jerome Richardson... I was there... Clark Terry saved us there... Mingus finally came back on with his bass

ctx.x: It was almost like a, I don’t know, all the greatest players—
You talked to Clark, right? Clark Terry?

items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There seemed to have been a whole West Coast contingent of people. Buddy Collette . . . [INTERVIEWEE] Buddy Collette.

ctx.x: There seemed to have been a whole West Coast contingent of people. Buddy Collette . . .
Marshal Royal, Ernie Royal. I don’t know whether – is Jerome Richardson from there?
